metadata.title: Clicked like I was allergic to shooting and somehow stole 1 clueless soul?! Valorant aim lost it...
metadata.description:
Me: panic-clicking like I forgot how to aim
Enemy: probably uninstalling from confusion
How did that even land? No clue but I’ll take it
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim’s as gloriously broken as mine!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
